# E-Commerce UI Redesign Guide

**Scope:** Any Spring Boot + MySQL marketplace (Thymeleaf, JSP, or Angular frontends).
**Direction:** Minimal, editorial, light theme only.
**Goal:** A store that looks designed by a person, not generated by a template or an AI tool.

---

## 1. Design Philosophy

The reference points are Apple's product pages, Aesop's online store, Cos, Kinfolk-style editorial layouts, and Etsy's calmer product grids. What they share:

1. **Content is the interface.** Product photos and type carry the page. Chrome (borders, boxes, shadows, badges) is minimal.
2. **Restraint.** One accent color, two typefaces, one corner radius, one spacing scale.
3. **Generous whitespace.** Space is used as a separator instead of boxes and lines.
4. **Real hierarchy.** Size, weight, and position establish importance, not color noise.
5. **Quiet motion.** Transitions confirm actions. They never decorate.

### Rules of thumb
- If an element can be removed without losing meaning, remove it.
- If two things look different, there must be a reason.
- If you reach for a shadow, try whitespace or a 1px hairline first.

---

## 2. Anti-"AI Slop" Checklist

These are the tells that make a site look auto-generated. **Do not use any of them.**

| Avoid | Why it reads as AI/template | Do instead |
|---|---|---|
| Purple/indigo → blue or pink gradients | The default "AI startup" look | Flat warm neutrals plus one muted accent |
| Gradient text on headings | Overused hero trope | Solid ink color, strong type |
| Glassmorphism, frosted cards, glow blobs | Decorative, hurts legibility | Flat surfaces, hairline borders |
| Neon accents, "cyber" dark mode | Off-brand for editorial commerce | Light paper tones |
| Emoji as icons or bullets (🚀 ✨ 🛒) | Instantly generic | Consistent line icon set or no icons |
| Cards with big radius plus big soft shadow on everything | Default Tailwind/Bootstrap demo look | Square or 2–4px radius, no shadow by default |
| Everything centered | Template feel | Left-aligned, asymmetric editorial layout |
| Inter + rounded cards + gray-50 background | The default stack | Distinct type pairing (Section 4) |
| Generic hero: "Welcome to our store" + stock gradient | Says nothing | Real product or category imagery, specific copy |
| Three identical feature boxes with icons ("Fast / Secure / Easy") | Filler | Cut, or replace with real info (shipping, returns) in one quiet line |
| Pill buttons with gradient fill and hover scale | Overdone | Solid rectangular button, subtle color shift |
| Lorem-style copy ("Discover amazing products") | Hollow | Short, concrete, specific copy |
| Bootstrap default blue `#0d6efd` | Unstyled framework default | Custom tokens |

---

## 3. Color System

A warm, paper-like neutral base with deep ink text and **one** restrained accent. No gradients anywhere.

### Tokens

```css
:root {
  /* Surfaces */
  --paper:        #F6F3EE;  /* page background (warm off-white) */
  --paper-raised: #FBFAF7;  /* inputs, drawers, popovers */
  --paper-sunk:   #EDE8E0;  /* image placeholders, subtle bands */

  /* Ink */
  --ink:          #1B1A17;  /* primary text */
  --ink-soft:     #55524B;  /* secondary text */
  --ink-faint:    #8A867D;  /* captions, placeholders (large text only) */

  /* Lines */
  --line:         #DDD7CC;  /* hairline borders */
  --line-strong:  #BDB6A8;  /* input borders, dividers */

  /* Accent: deep oxblood / brick. Used for links, sale, focus, primary CTA hover */
  --accent:       #8C3B2E;
  --accent-hover: #722E23;
  --accent-tint:  #F1E2DD;  /* very light accent background */

  /* Feedback (muted, not saturated) */
  --success:      #3F6B4F;
  --warning:      #A06A1C;
  --danger:       #A3302A;
}
```

### Usage rules
- **Page background:** `--paper`. Never pure `#FFFFFF` for the whole page.
- **Primary button:** background `--ink`, text `--paper`. Hover: `--accent`. This reads as editorial, not "SaaS blue."
- **Accent is rare.** Use it for sale prices, active nav indicator, text links in body copy, and keyboard focus. If more than ~5% of a screen is accent, reduce it.
- **Contrast:** body text `--ink` on `--paper` is above 15:1. `--ink-soft` is above 7:1. Use `--ink-faint` only for non-essential large text and placeholders.
- **Alternative accents** if oxblood doesn't suit the brand: deep forest `#2F5D46`, ink-navy `#23324A`, or ochre `#9A6B12`. Pick **one**.

---

## 4. Typography

Use a distinct pairing: an editorial serif for display plus a clean grotesque for UI and body.

| Role | Font | Fallback stack |
|---|---|---|
| Display / headings | **Newsreader** (or Instrument Serif, Fraunces if you want more character) | `Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif` |
| Body / UI | **Hanken Grotesk** (or Geist, Instrument Sans, DM Sans) | `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif` |
| Numerals (prices) | Body font with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` | same |

Load via Google Fonts or, preferably, **self-host WOFF2** (better performance and privacy):

```html
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hanken+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600&family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,500;1,6..72,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

### Type scale (fluid, 1.25 ratio)

```css
:root {
  --font-display: 'Newsreader', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  --font-body: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;

  --text-xs:   0.75rem;                              /* 12px, labels */
  --text-sm:   0.875rem;                             /* 14px, captions, meta */
  --text-base: 1rem;                                 /* 16px, body */
  --text-lg:   1.125rem;                             /* 18px, lead text */
  --text-xl:   clamp(1.35rem, 1.2rem + 0.6vw, 1.6rem);
  --text-2xl:  clamp(1.7rem, 1.4rem + 1.2vw, 2.25rem);
  --text-3xl:  clamp(2.2rem, 1.7rem + 2vw, 3.25rem);
  --text-hero: clamp(2.8rem, 2rem + 4vw, 5rem);
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--paper);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

h1, h2, h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 400;          /* editorial: light weights, large sizes */
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
```

### Typographic rules
- Headings are **regular weight, large size**. Avoid chunky bold headings.
- Eyebrow labels: uppercase, `--text-xs`, `letter-spacing: 0.12em`, `--ink-soft`. Use sparingly (one per section at most).
- Product names: body font, weight 500, `--text-base`. Prices directly below in `--ink-soft`, tabular numerals.
- Body line length: **60–75 characters** (`max-width: 65ch`).
- Use real typographic punctuation: ’ “ ” – —.
- No ALL CAPS for long text. No italic for emphasis in UI, only in editorial quotes/subheads.

---

## 5. Layout, Spacing, Shape

### Spacing scale (4px base)
```css
:root {
  --space-1: 0.25rem;  --space-2: 0.5rem;   --space-3: 0.75rem;
  --space-4: 1rem;     --space-5: 1.5rem;   --space-6: 2rem;
  --space-7: 3rem;     --space-8: 4.5rem;   --space-9: 7rem;
}
```
- Section vertical padding: `--space-8` desktop, `--space-7` mobile.
- Never use arbitrary values like 13px or 37px. Everything snaps to the scale.

### Grid
- Container: `max-width: 1320px; padding-inline: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 3rem)`.
- 12-column grid on desktop, 4 on mobile. Product grid: **4 columns ≥1200px, 3 ≥900px, 2 ≥600px.** On very small phones, 2 columns still works for product cards; avoid 1-column stacks of huge images.
- Allow **asymmetry**: editorial blocks like 7/5 split, offset images, one oversized tile in a grid. Not everything on a perfect equal grid.

### Shape and elevation
```css
:root {
  --radius: 2px;         /* the only radius; 0–4px. Pills only for tiny tags if at all */
  --shadow-none: none;
  --shadow-pop: 0 8px 24px rgba(27, 26, 23, 0.10);  /* only for dropdowns/drawers */
  --hairline: 1px solid var(--line);
}
```
- Default surfaces: **no shadow**, no border, or 1px hairline.
- Shadows only for things that float (mini-cart drawer, dropdown, toast).
- Images are **never** rounded heavily. Keep the same `--radius` or none.

### Imagery
- Consistent aspect ratio for product images: **4:5** (portrait) works best for editorial. Use `aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover;`.
- Background behind transparent product shots: `--paper-sunk`.
- Provide `width`/`height` attributes and `loading="lazy"` to avoid layout shift.
- Hover: swap to a second product image if available. Otherwise no zoom or scale effects.
- Use skeleton blocks in `--paper-sunk` (no shimmer gradients) while images load.

---

## 6. Components

### 6.1 Buttons
```css
.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2);
  padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem;
  font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1 var(--font-body);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
}
.btn:hover { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
.btn[disabled] { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }

.btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
.btn--ghost:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-color: var(--ink); }

.btn--link { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink); padding: 0;
  text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; }
.btn--link:hover { color: var(--accent); }
```
- Maximum **one** primary button per view region. Everything else is ghost or link.
- Button labels: short verbs ("Add to bag", "Checkout"). Not "Click here."

### 6.2 Header / Navigation
- Slim, **64–72px** tall, `--paper` background, 1px bottom hairline (appears only after scroll).
- Left: wordmark (display serif, ~22px). Center or left: 4–6 category links. Right: Search, Account, Bag (text with count, e.g. `Bag (2)`).
- Use **text links** over icon-only buttons where possible; it's more editorial and more accessible.
- Active link: 1px underline offset 6px in `--ink`. No pill backgrounds.
- Optional top announcement strip (shipping/returns): `--paper-sunk`, `--text-xs`, single line.
- Mobile: hamburger opens a full-height panel from the left (not a tiny dropdown). Links in display serif at `--text-xl`.
- Sticky header, no shrink animations.

### 6.3 Hero / Home
- **One** strong statement: large display serif headline (`--text-hero`), one-line subcopy, one CTA.
- Pair with a large real photograph, offset in an asymmetric 7/5 layout. No gradient overlays or stock "abstract" art.
- Below: editorial "collections" row, three category tiles of differing sizes with a label beneath each (not overlaid text with dark scrims).
- Then a curated product grid ("New arrivals"), then a simple info row: Shipping · Returns · Support, each a single line of text. No icon boxes.

### 6.4 Product Card
```
[ image 4:5                     ]
Product name                      ← 500 weight
Category / short descriptor       ← ink-soft, text-sm
₹1,299                            ← tabular nums
```
- No box, no shadow, no border. The image is the card.
- Hover: second image or underline on name. Quick-add button appears at the bottom of the image on hover (desktop only) as a small ghost button; on mobile, no quick add.
- Sale: original price in `--ink-faint` with line-through, sale price in `--accent`. No red "SALE!" starbursts. A tiny text label "Sale" in `--text-xs` uppercase is enough.
- Out of stock: image at 55% opacity plus "Sold out" text label. Don't hide.

### 6.5 Listing / Category Page
- Left-aligned page title (display serif) with item count in `--ink-soft`.
- Toolbar: filters (left) and sort (right). Filters as a **left sidebar** on desktop (collapsible groups, checkboxes with real labels) and a bottom sheet on mobile.
- Active filters displayed as removable text chips under the title ("Cotton ×").
- Pagination: simple "Previous · 1 2 3 · Next" text links, or a "Load more" ghost button. No big numbered boxes.
- Empty state: a clear sentence plus a "Clear filters" link. No cartoon illustrations.

### 6.6 Product Detail Page
- Two columns on desktop: **gallery (60%)** and **sticky purchase panel (40%)**.
- Gallery: vertical stack of large images on desktop (Apple/Aesop style) or a thumbnail rail plus main image. Swipeable on mobile with dots.
- Panel order: name (display serif `--text-2xl`) → price → short description → variant selectors → quantity → primary button → accordion (Details, Shipping, Returns).
- Variant selectors: size as square outlined boxes (selected = filled `--ink`), color as small swatches with a text label of the current selection.
- Accordions use a `+`/`–` glyph and hairline dividers.
- Show stock honestly ("Only 3 left") in `--warning` text, small.

### 6.7 Cart (Mini-cart drawer plus full page)
- Drawer slides in from the right, `--paper-raised`, `--shadow-pop`, 420px wide.
- Line item: small 4:5 thumbnail, name, variant, quantity stepper (– 1 +), price, and a "Remove" text link.
- Subtotal at the bottom, shipping note ("Shipping and taxes calculated at checkout"), one primary "Checkout" button.
- Cart page: item list left, order summary right (sticky). Hairline dividers between lines, no boxes around each item.

### 6.8 Checkout
- Single page or clear 3-step flow: **Contact → Delivery → Payment**. Show progress as plain text breadcrumb, not a colorful stepper.
- Single-column form, max-width 560px, labels **above** inputs (never placeholder-only labels).
- Order summary stays visible (right column, collapsible on mobile).
- Inline validation under each field in `--danger`, text only, no red boxes.
- Trust cues in text: "Secure payment", return policy link. No stock padlock/badge collage.

### 6.9 Forms and Inputs
```css
.input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  font: 400 var(--text-base)/1.4 var(--font-body);
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--paper-raised);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  transition: border-color .15s ease;
}
.input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft); }
.input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--ink); }
.input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--danger); }
.label { display: block; margin-bottom: var(--space-2); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 500; }
.help  { margin-top: var(--space-2); font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--ink-soft); }
.error { margin-top: var(--space-2); font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--danger); }
```

### 6.10 Auth Pages (Login / Register)
- Centered narrow column (max-width 420px) on `--paper`, **no card box, no shadow**.
- Display-serif heading ("Sign in"), fields, primary button, and a quiet "Create an account" link.
- Do not add decorative split screens with gradient art panels.

### 6.11 Admin Panel (if the project has one)
- Utility-first: denser, but same tokens. Table with hairline row dividers, sticky header row, 14px text.
- Left sidebar in `--paper-sunk` with text links. Active item: left 2px `--ink` bar.
- Status as plain text with a small colored dot (not saturated pill badges): `● Shipped`.
- Forms follow Section 6.9. Destructive actions are ghost buttons with `--danger` text and need a confirm step.

### 6.12 Footer
- `--paper-sunk` background. 3–4 columns of text links in `--text-sm`, wordmark and one sentence, newsletter field (single line input plus ghost button), legal row at the bottom.
- No social icon rainbow. Text links or monochrome icons only.

### 6.13 Feedback: Toasts, Alerts, Empty States
- Toast: bottom-left, `--ink` background, `--paper` text, 2px radius, auto-dismiss in 4s, `role="status"`.
- Inline alerts: left 2px border in the semantic color, `--paper-raised` background, plain text. No emoji.
- Empty states: one sentence plus one action. E.g., "Your bag is empty. Continue shopping →".

---

## 7. Motion

```css
:root {
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .0, .0, 1);
  --dur-fast: 150ms;
  --dur-base: 220ms;
  --dur-slow: 400ms;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
}
```
- Allowed: color/opacity transitions, drawer slide (`transform`), accordion height, fade-in of images on load.
- Not allowed: bouncing, parallax, scroll-jacking, hover scale pops, floating animated blobs, typewriter text, confetti.
- Page load: simple 200ms opacity fade at most.

---

## 8. Iconography
- Use **one** line icon family at 1.5px stroke (e.g., Lucide, Phosphor Regular, or Heroicons Outline). Never mix sets.
- Size: 20px in UI, 24px max. Icons always inherit `currentColor`.
- Icons-only buttons need `aria-label`. Prefer a text label when space allows.

---

## 9. Copywriting
- Short, specific, calm. Examples:
  - ❌ "Discover amazing products you'll love!" → ✅ "New this week."
  - ❌ "Add to Cart 🛒" → ✅ "Add to bag"
  - ❌ "Oops! Something went wrong 😢" → ✅ "We couldn't save that. Please try again."
- Sentence case everywhere, not Title Case On Every Heading.
- Use real product names, real descriptions, real prices in seed data. Seed data with "Product 1 / Lorem ipsum" makes any design look fake.

---

## 10. Accessibility (non-negotiable)
- Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (body) and ≥ 3:1 (large text, UI borders).
- Visible keyboard focus on every interactive element (`:focus-visible`, 2px `--accent` outline).
- Minimum touch target 44×44px.
- Semantic HTML: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`, `<button>` for actions, `<a>` for navigation.
- All product images have meaningful `alt`. Decorative images use `alt=""`.
- Form fields have associated `<label for>`; errors linked with `aria-describedby`.
- Don't rely on color alone for state (add text or underline).
- Cart count updates announced via `aria-live="polite"`.

---

## 11. Responsive Behavior

| Breakpoint | Behavior |
|---|---|
| < 600px | 2-col product grid, hamburger nav, bottom-sheet filters, sticky "Add to bag" bar on PDP |
| 600–899px | 2–3 col grid, condensed header |
| 900–1199px | 3 col grid, sidebar filters appear |
| ≥ 1200px | 4 col grid, full layout, sticky PDP panel |

Mobile-first CSS: write base styles for small screens and enhance with `min-width` media queries.

---

## 12. Implementation Guide (Spring Boot specifics)

### 12.1 File structure
```
src/main/resources/
├── static/
│   ├── css/
│   │   ├── tokens.css        # all :root variables from this doc
│   │   ├── base.css          # reset, typography, body
│   │   ├── components.css    # buttons, inputs, cards, header, footer
│   │   └── pages.css         # page-specific layouts (home, PDP, cart, checkout)
│   ├── fonts/                # self-hosted WOFF2
│   ├── img/
│   └── js/
│       └── app.js            # drawer, accordion, quantity stepper (vanilla)
└── templates/
    ├── fragments/
    │   ├── head.html         # fonts, css includes
    │   ├── header.html
    │   └── footer.html
    └── ...pages
```

### 12.2 Thymeleaf
- Put header/footer/head in fragments and include with `th:replace="~{fragments/header :: header}"`.
- Use `th:href="@{/css/tokens.css}"` for asset links.
- Format prices consistently: `th:text="${#numbers.formatDecimal(product.price, 1, 'COMMA', 2, 'POINT')}"` (or your locale's currency format).

### 12.3 JSP
- Use `<jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/views/fragments/header.jsp"/>` or JSP tag files for header/footer.
- Format prices with `<fmt:formatNumber value="${p.price}" type="currency" currencyCode="INR"/>`.

### 12.4 Angular
- Place tokens in `src/styles.css` (global). Component styles reference tokens only. No hard-coded colors.
- Use Angular `NgOptimizedImage` for product images.

### 12.5 CSS approach
- **Remove** default Bootstrap theme colors if present. If you must keep Bootstrap's grid/utilities, override its variables (`--bs-primary`, `--bs-body-bg`, `--bs-body-font-family`, `--bs-border-radius`) with your tokens, and avoid default `.btn-primary`, `.card`, `.navbar-dark` looks.
- Preferably use plain CSS with the tokens above. This project's UI is small enough that a framework isn't needed.

### 12.6 Performance
- Serve images as WebP/AVIF with responsive `srcset`; store thumbnails and full sizes.
- Enable Spring static resource caching:
  ```properties
  spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.max-age=365d
  spring.web.resources.chain.strategy.content.enabled=true
  spring.web.resources.chain.strategy.content.paths=/**
  ```
- Use `font-display: swap` and preload the two main font files.

---

## 13. Page-by-Page Redesign Order

Do the work in this order; each step is shippable.

1. **Tokens and base** — `tokens.css`, `base.css`, fonts, body/typography. The site already looks different after this.
2. **Header, footer, buttons, inputs** — the shared components.
3. **Product card and listing page** — the core browsing experience.
4. **Product detail page** — gallery, purchase panel, accordions.
5. **Cart drawer and cart page**.
6. **Checkout and auth pages**.
7. **Home page** — last, once components exist.
8. **Admin panel** — dense variant of the same system.
9. **Polish** — empty states, error pages (404/500 in editorial style), focus states, motion, a11y audit.

---

## 14. Definition of Done / Review Checklist

- [ ] Only **two** font families in use; weights limited to 400/500/600.
- [ ] Only **one** accent color; no gradients anywhere.
- [ ] No pure white page background; no pure black text.
- [ ] One radius value (0–4px) across the site.
- [ ] No shadows except floating elements.
- [ ] No emoji in UI text or icons.
- [ ] All spacing values come from the scale.
- [ ] All product images share the same aspect ratio.
- [ ] Only one primary button per region.
- [ ] Keyboard-only walkthrough of browse → add to bag → checkout works with visible focus.
- [ ] Lighthouse: Accessibility ≥ 95, Performance ≥ 85 on mobile.
- [ ] Squint test: blur your eyes at the page. You should see clear hierarchy: image, name, price, action.
- [ ] Show it to someone for five seconds. If they say "looks like a template," revisit hero, imagery, and copy.

---

## 15. Reference Inspiration (look, don't copy)
Study these for layout rhythm, type, and restraint:
- **Aesop**: typography, warm neutrals, calm product pages.
- **Apple Store**: product gallery storytelling, whitespace, sticky purchase panel.
- **Cos / Arket**: editorial grids, asymmetric layouts, restrained palette.
- **Etsy**: marketplace conventions done cleanly (cards, seller info, filters).
- **Muji**: utility plus minimalism, honest product presentation.
- **Linear / Stripe docs** (for admin and form clarity only): tight spacing, clear hierarchy.

Study how they handle: header height, image ratio, price placement, filter UI, cart drawer, and empty states. Then implement with your own tokens.
